source: Datos de juego abreviados de The Maze (M. A. Bastarrachea Magnani, Axo stories). El detalle está en la página indicada.

items.name: Bone
items.Uses: One of the most important uses of dried bones in the Maze is to ignite and feed the Bonfires

items.name: Brass
items.Uses: It can be employed to craft pieces and parts of complex devices, like clocks, musical instruments, and magic items

items.name: Bronze
items.Uses: It can be used to craft armor and weapons

items.name: Carbon
items.Uses: The main use of coal is for combustion in the Bonfires

items.name: Chitin
items.Uses: It can be used to craft shields, medium and heavy armor

items.name: Copper
items.Uses: The softness of copper prevents it from being used for crafting armor and weapons, but it can be used to coat armor and weapons

items.name: Electrum
items.Uses: It can be used to craft armor and weapons

items.name: Flint
items.Uses: Flint can be used to craft light and one-handed, bludgeoning weapons, spears, axes, daggers, and arrowheads

items.name: Gemstones
items.Uses: In the Maze, they are almost useless except to craft magic items and complex devices

items.name: Gold
items.Uses: Because of its softness, it is not usually employed to craft armor or weapons

items.name: Granite
items.Uses: Granite can be employed for building, mainly doors and barricades to defend the Bonfires

items.name: Halite
items.Uses: Salt can be used to cure and dry food, as a flavor enhancer, and to preserve ice

items.name: Iron
items.Uses: It can be employed to craft weapons, armor, and any kind of tools or equipment

items.name: Lead
items.Uses: It can be used to craft pieces and parts of simple devices like bullets and pipes

items.name: Leather
items.Uses: It can be used to make light and medium armor

items.name: Marble
items.Uses: Marble can be employed for sculpture, building, and even pottery

items.name: Wood
items.Uses: Although the primary use of wood is to feed the Bonfires, it can be used to make weapons and armor

items.name: Pewter
items.Uses: Although it is possible to make weapons and armor made of Pewter, it is better suited to craft pots, pans, tableware, and tools

items.name: Silver
items.Uses: Just like Gold, Silver is usually not suitable to craft armor or weapons, but it can be used to make light weapons that do piercing or slashing damage

items.name: Steel
items.Uses: It is the base metal for armor, weapons, and tools

items.name: Tin
items.Uses: The main use of Tin is to combine it to obtain Bronze and Pewter

items.name: Zinc
items.Uses: The main use of Zinc is to combine it to obtain Brass

items.name: Adamantine
items.Uses: Adamantine can be used to craft armor, shields, and weapons

items.name: Aurorum
items.Uses: Aurorum is employed to craft weapons, armor, and tools

items.name: Blacksteel
items.Uses: Blacksteel can be used to craft armor, shields, and weapons

items.name: (The) Black Stone
items.Uses: If it has any use, the Black Stone would be employed only for construction

items.name: Darkwood
items.Uses: Darkwood can be used to craft any wooden item, making it more durable

items.name: Impervious Quartz
items.Uses: Impervious Quartz can be used to make weapons and tools

items.name: Inertial Granite
items.Uses: Inertial Granite is mainly employed to craft bludgeoning weapons

items.name: Mithral
items.Uses: Due to its flexibility, it is optimal to craft lighter armors, but it is possible to find weapons made of it

items.name: Mournsteel
items.Uses: While it is favored for weapons, it can be used to make armor too

items.name: Occasium
items.Uses: Occasium has broad uses, from weapons and armor to components of complex devices and wondrous items

items.name: Orichalcum
items.Uses: Orichalcum is employed to craft armors and weapons

items.name: Sapient Wood
items.Uses: Sapient Wood is mostly employed to make wondrous items

items.name: Sapient Metal
items.Uses: Finding Sapient Metal is a once-in-a-lifetime event, just like forging it

items.name: Seide
items.Uses: Clothes, light armor, and chain shirts can be made of Seide

items.name: Umbrium
items.Uses: Umbrium is employed to craft light weapons and armor
